phone.changelog: Introduces 60 FPS animated watch faces & live touch interactivity. Adds 9 innovative dials to Store (Quantum Sonar Radar HUD, Cyberpunk Pulse ECG, Kinetic Tourbillon Haute, Neon Audio Spectrum VU, Cosmos Orbital Gravity, Liquid Mercury Flow, Bioluminescent Aurora, Zen Water Ripple, F1 Telemetry Velocity) with Animated & Interactive filter chips and live preview badges.

watch.changelog: Adds real-time 60 FPS animation canvas engine and interactive touch controller (tap-to-cycle neon palettes, mode toggles, water ripples) for animated dials installed from the Phone App Store, with zero idle battery drain in ambient/AOD mode.
